case.title: rangePlugin and allowInput: Left/right arrow keys doesn't work in second input
case.reason: Upstream comment explicitly reproduces 4.6.1 and checks 4.6.13. Use two range input fields with real typing and ArrowLeft on the second.

case.title: Issue where time won't change from 12:00 on first attempt
case.reason: 4.6.6 is reported affected. Release notes list the fix at v4.6.9. Defer the initial date, enter hour 16 on an empty time-only picker, and press Enter.

case.title: The Clear method doesn't clear the selected range
case.reason: Upstream identifies #654 as duplicate of #642, so count the pair once. 3.5.3 is reported affected and 3.6.0 is the first available stable npm package after the fix. Click the standard Clear button and observe stale in-range cells.

case.title: Ошибка при нажатии на кнопку escape при скрытом datepicker'е
case.reason: The maintainer names 3.5.4 as fixed, but official npm has no such version. 3.6.0 is the first published stable after the linked commit, and 3.5.3 is the previous published release. Use the documented custom show event, focus the input while picker remains closed, then press Escape.
